name: Relative Volume v2
description: Relative volume = current_volume / SMA(volume, period). Five-zone classification (extreme/high/normal/low/minimal) and threshold-cross triggers (spike/extreme/fade).
author: user

output_descriptions.EXTREME: Relative volume above 3x the rolling SMA — exceptional activity
output_descriptions.HIGH: Relative volume between 1.5x and 3x the SMA — elevated participation
output_descriptions.NORMAL: Relative volume between 0.75x and 1.5x the SMA — typical activity
output_descriptions.LOW: Relative volume between 0.5x and 0.75x the SMA — quiet participation
output_descriptions.MINIMAL: Relative volume below 0.5x the SMA — exceptionally quiet
